title: Adaptive Deadline- and Energy-Aware Caching Algorithms in Dynamic Multi-UAV Edge Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.30768v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Content caching via unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) becomes one of the solutions to maintain content delivery when terrestrial infrastructure is unavailable or disrupted. However, existing caching approaches often focus primarily on cache-hit performance or average delivery delay, without jointly addressing spatially heterogeneous and time-varying demand, content-specific deadlines, and uneven communication-energy consumption across UAVs. To address these challenges, we formulate a dynamic deadline- and energy-aware cache placement and replacement problem that jointly considers deadline misses, UAV-side communication energy, and inter-UAV energy imbalance. To achieve this, we first develop deadline- and energy-aware UBAC (DE-UBAC), an interpretable hierarchical rule-based realization that incorporates deadline-aware prioritization, cooperative placement, energy-aware coordination, and cache-update cost. translated_title: 动态多无人机边缘网络中自适应的截止时间与能耗感知缓存算法
translated_abstract: 基于无人机（UAV）的内容缓存成为在地面基础设施不可用或受损时维持内容分发的解决方案之一。然而，现有的缓存方法通常主要关注缓存命中率或平均交付时延，未能联合处理空间异构且随时间变化的需求、内容特定的截止时间要求，以及各无人机之间不均衡的通信能耗。为应对这些挑战，我们构建了一个动态的截止时间与能耗感知的缓存放置与替换问题，该问题联合考虑了截止时间错过、无人机侧通信能耗以及无人机之间的能耗不均衡。为此，我们首先开发了截止时间与能耗感知的UBAC（DE-UBAC），这是一种可解释的、基于规则的分层实现方法，融合了截止时间感知的优先级排序、协作式放置、能耗感知协调以及缓存更新代价。然而，预先定义的优先级以及……
tldr: 论文针对多无人机边缘网络提出了一个联合考虑截止时间错过、通信能耗与机间能耗不均衡的动态缓存放置与替换问题，并开发了可解释的分层规则算法DE-UBAC来实现截止时间与能耗感知的缓存管理。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates a dynamic cache placement and replacement problem in multi-UAV edge networks that jointly considers deadline misses, UAV communication energy, and inter-UAV energy imbalance, and develops DE-UBAC, an interpretable hierarchical rule-based algorithm for deadline- and energy-aware caching.
